duke.name: Duke Energy
duke.clause: “All content on this Site ... is intended solely for your own internal residential or business use ... You may not reproduce (except as noted above), publish, transmit, distribute, display, modify, create derivative works from, sell or participate in any sale of or exploit in any way, in whole or in part, any Content or the Site.” (Terms of Use, last updated April 3, 2023)
duke.reason: No commercial-use or republication permission; automated access is also restricted. Show unavailable plus the official link.

dominion.name: Dominion Energy
dominion.clause: Terms of use page not retrievable on 2026-11-28 (dominionenergy.com/legal/terms-of-use returned 404). The lake page says: “Current and historic flow release data can be obtained from the U.S. Geological Survey and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.”
dominion.reason: Permission not confirmed. Use public-domain USGS gauges where they exist (reviewed separately), otherwise unavailable plus the official link.

tva.name: Tennessee Valley Authority
tva.clause: Listed on data.gov as dataset TVA-DATA-000002 “Lake Levels” (contact opendata@tva.gov). The site terms page (“Important Information Regarding the Use of This TVA Website”) could not be retrieved, so no reuse clause was confirmed.
tva.reason: Likely usable (federal agency, open-data listing), but reuse terms are not yet confirmed in writing. Ask opendata@tva.gov before use. No pilot ramps affected.

cube.name: Cube Hydro Carolinas (Yadkin Project)
cube.clause: No terms of use found (cubecarolinas.com/terms-of-use returned 404). The page says the information “is designed to provide accurate and timely information regarding current lake levels; however, this information is subject to change.”
cube.reason: No permission located. Show unavailable plus the official link. No pilot ramps affected.
